Maine Senate Debate Features Clashes on Iran, Prices, and Protests

The final televised debate for the Maine US Senate race saw incumbent Republican Senator Susan Collins and Democratic challenger Angus King clash over issues including Iran and consumer prices. A protester interrupted the debate, shouting about data centers, leading to a heated exchange where one candidate told the protester to "shut up." Former President Trump's influence was also noted as a point of tension.
